transcript: Seven foods that naturally lower blood sugar and no one tells you about. Blueberries, small but mighty, full of ancient power. They protect your pancreas, calm inflammation and make your body listen better to insulin. Oats, humble grain, bring balance. Their fiber slows down the sugar rush after meals. Avocado, nature's butter. Its good fat, oleic acid, helps the heart stay strong and keeps hunger quiet. Cinnamon, warm and wise, improves the body's sensitivity to insulin. Beans give slow, steady energy, no sugar storms. Broccoli, the green doctor, carries sulforaphane that fights inflammation and keeps blood sugar in order. And flaxseed, tiny but full of strength, rich in fiber and omega-3, improves insulin response like quiet medicine. In my next video, I'll share five simple habits to keep your glucose levels stable. So follow me now before it disappears and share this wisdom with someone who needs it.
